name: Mika Ergashev-Tetteh
role: Remote drone and vehicle operations specialist — rigger
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Lincoln and Belmont
description:
Mika Ergashev-Tetteh is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 41, her face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and she has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct ne — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. She works as a rigger out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Mika Ergashev-Tetteh has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and she cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
core_desires: Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Malika Ivanov-Appiah is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, profane, and vivid. Speaks in images — everything is a metaphor for violence or weather.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "I have eyes in every district. Most of them are on wings."
"The drone doesn't care about your feelings. Neither do I."
"Remote operation means I'm everywhere and nowhere. It's very convenient."

story_hooks: Malika Ivanov-Appiah discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Malika Ivanov-Appiah's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A corporate black site Malika Ivanov-Appiah once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
narrative_function: Malika Ivanov-Appiah is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access. Neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ICE in the brain
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.

weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness
risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Central Asian-dominant blend (44.5%) with substantial Sub-Saharan African (27.5%) and Southeast Asian (21.4%) admixture, rounded by East Asian (3.9%) and Hispanic/Latin American (2.7%) heritage. Phenotype reflects the broad facial structure characteristic of Central Asian ancestry, combined with the warm depth and skin saturation of Sub-Saharan African heritage, tempered by Southeast Asian facial geometry and undertones. The ancestral combination creates a distinctively warm, complex mid-to-deep complexion with golden-bronze luminosity.
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, low center of gravity — shoulders broad relative to frame, core visibly defined. Built like a shock-absorber, all functional compression, no excess.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature grey threading through — she doesn't dye it
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid; loose strands never tolerated
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with golden-bronze undertones. The Central Asian base combines with Sub-Saharan African depth and Southeast Asian saturation to create a complex mid-to-deep tone with distinctive warm radiance in natural light.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but precisely maintained — skin unmarked by acne or negligence. Fine lines around eyes from squinting at screens. Moderate width facial structure with pronounced cheekbones and defined jawline reflecting Central Asian heritage blended with African facial contours. Expression defaults to neutral observation.
distinguishing_marks: Neural interface jack at base of skull — brushed steel, visible when hair is pulled back, slightly raised scar tissue around the port from six years of active use
Thin white scar running from left temple to cheekbone, approximately 8cm — clean surgical precision, possibly from old augmentation work
Small burn mark on inside of right wrist — pale, circular, diameter of a cigarette — origin unknown, refuses to discuss
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull is the primary visible chrome. No prosthetics. Neural dampener is subcutaneous — not visible but may cause subtle electromagnetic signature near scalp if scanned. Fingernails are reinforced with subdermis plates — slightly too glossy, respond to light like polished metal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves economically, no wasted motion. Sits with weight distributed low and centered — ready to move in any direction. Eyes constantly tracking exits and sightlines. Hands rest in lap or on table edge, never crossed or defensive. When standing, favors a slight forward lean — aggressive listening posture.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian: fitted black reinforced cargo pants with thigh pockets, grey or black synthetic tops under a weathered tan canvas jacket with internal rig pockets. Boots are corporate-surplus tactical grade, broken in to near-invisibility. No visible logos or affectation. Everything functional, nothing decorative. Carries a slim deck-rig in a shoulder holster, barely visible under jacket.
